responsibility: Defines the specialized BIR builder for lazy boolean expressions whose short-circuit control flow cannot be emitted as an ordinary binary operator. It introduces the extra short_circuit basic-block context, builds a result place and the branching structure for &&/||-style evaluation, and otherwise forwards non-lazy subexpressions to the regular ExprStmtBuilder, making this file responsible specifically for preserving Rust short-circuit semantics in BIR CFG form.
